description: This Java source file defines a public interface 'Command' for Ditto commands, including nested enums and classes for command categories and JSON field definitions, serving as a base for all command implementations in the project.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Base interface for all commands understood by Ditto, providing methods and constants for command types, categories, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Command.Category
classes.description: Enumeration categorizing commands into QUERY, MODIFY, and DELETE types.

classes.name: Command.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains common JSON field definitions for Command objects, including command ID and type fields.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix of this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category to which this command belongs.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the command, returning the command object.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version the command implements, defaulting to latest if not specified.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representation of this command, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command to JSON with specified schema version and filtering predicate.
